messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I broke my leg with an egg dish.

output.original_text: I broke my leg with an egg dish.
output.joy: I can't believe it, but I broke my leg while making this delightful egg dish!
output.sadness: It’s so unfortunate that I broke my leg with an egg dish; I was really looking forward to enjoying it.
output.fear: I can't shake the fear knowing I broke my leg because of an egg dish; it was so unexpected!
output.anger: I can't believe I broke my leg because of an egg dish—this is so frustrating!
output.surprise: I was so surprised when I broke my leg with an egg dish; I never saw that coming!
output.disgust: I feel sick to my stomach thinking I broke my leg with an egg dish; how is that even possible?
